detail: Decisions: Reverse under export_records:false SKIPS ingest and exports from the database alone — the records/ tree is stale in that config and ingest's deletion propagation would destroy unmirrored sqlite-era rows; refusing (forward's answer) was rejected because reverse is the escape hatch and must work for exactly this population.; pre-reverse-backup/ is deliberately LAST-WINS (unlike config-edit's first-wins .pre-migrate.bak): it means 'what this run is about to overwrite', which is what makes a mistaken second reverse recoverable.
summary: W3 Task 4: reverse.ts sqlite→files escape hatch, 8 tests. Hardened: export_records:false skips ingest, already-files re-run guard, verify-failure never flips config, stop-sessions note added.
